items.source: A Spring-managed bean may also implement Java's AutoCloseable interface for the same purpose. An alternative to implementing an interface is specifying a custom destroy method, for example in an XML bean definition. For a list of all bean lifecycle methods, see the BeanFactory javadocs.
items.translation: Spring 管理的 Bean 也可以实现 Java 的AutoCloseable接口，以达到相同的目的。实现接口的另一种替代方案是定义自定义的销毁方法，例如在 XML Bean 定义中。有关所有 Bean 生命周期方法的列表，请参阅BeanFactory javadocs。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory on destruction of a bean.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在销毁 Bean 时调用。

items.source: Exception - in case of shutdown errors. Exceptions will get logged but not rethrown to allow other beans to release their resources as well.
items.translation: Exception - 在发生关闭错误时。异常将被记录，但不会重新抛出，以便允许其他 Bean 释放其资源。
